observations.why: A gate requiring signed manifests before shipping appeals to security and stability as the good.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Framing past security incidents as the justification for the gate appeals to preventing recurrence — conservation.
Restating the gate as a requirement appeals to security and stability as the governing good.
Extending the gate's scope to both staging and production appeals to comprehensive security coverage.
